g.text: Codex Development Workflow - Unified PR-Gated Lifecycle
Read current state + architecture + relevant code
Persist parent plan + Ticket Issues before branching.
One Ticket owns one branch and PR; its Slices share it.
Dependent Tickets start after prerequisites merge.
Use one Slice without a Ticket when one behavior
can be planned, implemented, tested, and reviewed
as one unit. This never removes the branch or PR gate.
Start Automatic Review immediately after the PR
is created or updated; do not wait for confirmation.
Blocking findings repeat Fix -> Test -> Redaction
See review-execution.svg for scope and recovery.
Main agent owns integration and final judgment.
No overlapping files or shared interfaces in parallel.
Failed validation -> fix and rerun affected checks.
More Slices -> repeat implementation and validation.
Publication waits for the whole unit's acceptance.
Verify actual push URL(s) and destination branch.
Unknown targets and default-branch publication block.
All file types require a PR; never direct-push main.
Update the recovery snapshot only after merge,
If tracked State / Docs change, use the same
feature-branch and PR gate for that follow-up change.
Docs, Code, Tests, Config, Refactor, Bugfix,
Feature, Dependency, and CI/CD changes all use
this lifecycle. No direct default-branch delivery.
